```{r}
penguins = readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmegahed/isa401/main/data/penguin_captures.csv")
penguins$species
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load dataset
penguins <- readr::read_csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmegahed/isa401/main/data/penguin_captures.csv")

# 1. Total Captures (Rows) — What Grok & OpenAI calculated
captures_count <- penguins |> 
  dplyr::count(species, name = "total_captures")

# 2. Unique Penguins (Unit of Analysis = Penguin/Band)
unique_penguins_count <- penguins |> 
  dplyr::distinct(species, band) |> 
  dplyr::count(species, name = "unique_penguins")

# Combine results side-by-side
dplyr::left_join(unique_penguins_count, captures_count, by = "species") |> 
  dplyr::arrange(desc(unique_penguins))
```

```{r}
library(ellmer)

# 1. Create a chat object
chat = ellmer::chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna", # note that the API Key that I provided only works with 5.6 luna
  params = ellmer::params(reasoning_effort = "none")
)

# 2. Define the Airbnb listing description
description <- "This one of a kind, turn of the century, fully restored mansion is just waiting for you to come and enjoy the vast amenities this house offers! This historic Victorian Mansion was built in the last 1800's and has been fully restored and updated with one thing in mind--luxury! We boast a slate pool table, 10 person hot tub, a custom made fire table, a built in giant projector screen for streaming, arcade games, and much much more! We comfortably sleep 19 guests with 9 dedicated bedrooms."

# 3. Define the structured output schema
schema <- ellmer::type_object(
  property_type = ellmer::type_string(),
  max_guests = ellmer::type_integer(),
  num_bedrooms = ellmer::type_integer(),
  key_amenities = ellmer::type_string(
    "List key amenities separated by |"
  )
)

# 4. Extract structured information
result <- chat$chat_structured(
  description,
  type = schema
)

# 5. Display results
print(result)
```

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"

# 9 pages covering 360 total wrecks (40 per page)
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 321, by = 40)

pages = vector("list", length(starts))

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  # Construct exam registry URL
  pg_url = paste0(base, "/exam/registry?start=", starts[i])
  pg = rvest::read_html(pg_url)
  
  # Extract class and salvage value for all 40 wrecks on the page
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> 
      rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |> 
      rvest::html_text2()
  )
  
  Sys.sleep(1) # Respect robots.txt crawl-delay
}

# Row-bind all pages into one dataset (360 rows total)
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)

# Extract single vector of all ship classes
classes = registry$class
classes
# Filter Dreadnoughts and sum total salvage value
dreadnoughts_df = registry |> 
  dplyr::filter(class == "Dreadnought")

# Output count & sum
nrow(dreadnoughts_df)
sum(dreadnoughts_df$value, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(httr2)

resp <- request("https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json") |>
  req_url_query(
    `$select` = "count(*) AS n",
    `$where` = "crashdate >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00' AND crashdate < '2026-08-01T00:00:00'"
  ) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

as.integer(resp[[1]]$n)
```

```{r}
library(httr2)

resp <- request("https://data.cincinnati-oh.gov/resource/rvmt-pkmq.json") |>
  req_url_query(
    # Count distinct crash IDs rather than total rows
    `$select` = "count(*) AS records, count(distinct instanceid) AS crashes",
    `$where` = "crashdate >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00' AND crashdate < '2026-08-01T00:00:00'"
  ) |>
  req_perform() |>
  resp_body_json()

# Extract unique crash count


crashes_count <- as.integer(resp[[1]][["crashes"]])
crashes_count
records_count <- as.integer(resp[[1]][["records"]])
```
